verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent runtime (buzz-agent) is explicitly documented as an MCP client — 'call the LLM → get tool calls → run them via MCP' — and it is paired with buzz-dev-mcp, an MCP server providing shell/file tools. The Persona Pack spec further lets users bundle 'MCP server config' into a persona so an agent can use external tools. This is first-party documentation only, with no independent/hands-on confirmation that arbitrary third-party MCP servers can be plugged in smoothly. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of adding external MCP servers, and clearer end-user instructions for connecting arbitrary third-party MCP servers (not just the bundled buzz-dev-mcp).
